high_level_description: The image is a split cover of Time magazine's "Person of the Year" issue for 2023, titled "The Architects of AI." The left side of the cover features a large, intricate structure that resembles the letter "AI," constructed from scaffolding and various mechanical components. The structure appears to be under construction, with workers in hard hats and safety gear scattered around it, indicating ongoing development or assembly. The background is a plain white, which makes the black and metallic elements of the structure stand out prominently.
